facts.fact: LRRRC, the Immigration Service and the National Identification Registry signed a tripartite MoU on 25 February 2026 under which NIR captures and verifies refugee biometrics and eligible refugees will be issued biometric Resident Permits and Specialized Refugee Identification Cards.
